pieces.sentence: Look into my mirror and you'll see my current project, walking and swinging my arms to type Morse code.

Look into my mirror and you'll wear the southern cross stars from the New Zealand flag, Manuka flowers and clouds because I'm from New Zealand, I love the Manuka honey we get back which come from our native Manuka flower trees. I also added the cloud because its typically cloudy and pretty windy back home.
